sensorReceiver.observer: Read world.galactic.radarContacts plus campaign.contacts confidence/identified/uncertainty; only live local actually rendered radar reports sound. Hidden designer transitions consumed; no hidden coordinates read. Optional world.solarIntel() supplies only actually activated disclosed/observed, precise, matching-system scans with finite position, startedAt and duration evaluated against authoritative simulation time. Explicit disclosed:false fails closed.
sensorReceiver.coalesce: Actual ping/sweep takes one shared report slot and consumes same-tick contact transitions; never queue fleet-sized reports. Suppress restored/save/view/pause scan baselines, repeated IDs, late disclosure, future/expired scans and confidence jitter. Scan ID uses system/emitter/mode/startedAt. Receiver reports consume legacy contact:ui even when full voice pool; successful ACTIVE PING toast has no generic confirm before the actual emission. Actual solar uncertainty preserved; uncertainty drift threshold max(28m,20% of best prior solution).
sensorReceiver.voicePolicy: Priority0, at most existing64 pool; reports never steal a gun voice; skip while Alerts0/masterMute; no new oscillator/timer/assets.
sensorReceiver.music: sensorTension<=.55, rise2.5s/release5s; contribution=tension*max(0,1-combatIntensity/.35); existing score-pulse +.18*contribution, danger +.10*contribution, bed LP -350*contribution. Existing Music/master/mute and duck buses retain control.

solarReceiver.instance: receiver-owned ECM loop separate from ambient shipboard instance
solarReceiver.quietMusicContribution: max(existing receiver tension,.22*ecmStrength), 2.5s rise/5s release; suppressed in music at battle intensity>=.35

observedEwReceiver.voiceRule: Only if global gun pool<64, Alerts>0 and not muted; no gun stealing

guardianAccents.source: Actual committed solarIntel().guardianEvents with currently disclosed precise identified guardian bodies
guardianAccents.position: Only actual public accepted emitter/intercept position; no raw recon/hidden wing/model access

authorization.event: disclosed===true, observed===true, precise===true, sourceId present, confidence>=.72, finite at/position/direction
authorization.realProducers: Finite charged20fuel EMP, fuel-spent feeding, accepted onLaunch kinetic/flak and actual intercept; rejected fitted-weapon queries never qualify

guardianAccents.noImmediateRepeats: Stable event-ID dedupe256; no historical or missed-mute backlog; no queue

retirement.revokedBodyOrSource: cancel gain ramp,4ms time constant,stop within18ms
retirement.audioContextSuspension: immediate zero and stop; silent resume baseline
retirement.dispose: stop/disconnect every owned source and clear observations

guardianAccents.nativeHostRequirements: Reuse existing named SoundCues/waves. Instance override to Ambience is required despite the canonical weapon bank bus. Apply gain/rate/duration/lowpass/distance/cadence and two-background-voice cap in host; never play another full gun/blast or continuously loop these samples. Metadata registration is not native gameplay proof.

mix.note: Cue assets remain unity gain/pitch. These are existing browser mixer settings for a port adapter, not DSP baked into imported Unreal assets.

eventVariation.roundRobin: Full shuffled bag, every take once before refill; boundary swap prevents immediate last-take repetition. UI and score unchanged.
eventVariation.bakedLayerSelection: All20 families have8 unique takes and >=2 actual source-layer combinations. PDC layer selection is baked, never stacked. V7 seven guided phase/motor families also each8 unique physical takes and >=2 actual source-layer combinations.

spatialPolicy.sizeUnits: game hull length; unitsToCentimeters100 applies native distances
spatialPolicy.PDCSizeModulation: fixed30 to preserve calibrated short burst weight

guidedMotorPolicy.lifetime: Strict motorActive===true only. Evaluate guided routes every audio.update frame, independent of100ms score/hull cadence.12ms powered gain attack; cancel stale automation and fade4ms/stop18ms on actual coast/done/generation/map/remote/pause. Brief correction and heavy terminal pulses resume motor only, never first ignition.
guidedMotorPolicy.filter: Existing near filter unchanged; heavy distance>1000 additionally caps lowpass at360*(distance/1000)^(-.20)Hz. No additional loops; two nearest actually powered eligible bodies total.

damageObservation.breach: Read actual campaignUnit.damageControl.sections (or ship.damageControl.sections) breach counts; visual holes cap at6 and can remain after patch. Observe new increases only, no restored-save startup reports; legacy visual-count fallback only without compartment state. Never modify damage.
damageObservation.vent: At most2 nearest live local hulls whose actual section breaches>0 and pressure>.025. Finite1.8s releases gated1.8s; patch, repair or depressurization stops new releases. Legacyfallback requires visual breaches and hp<95% only if no section state.

guidedPhasePolicy.dedup: Audio-owned WeakMap keyed object identity plus guidedGeneration; first cold release and first ignition only. Coast correction never replays ignition. Old flying objects discovered from load/view do not invent launch reports. Consume remote/paused transitions without delayed replay. Callback timing authoritative;Per-frame observer fallback supports older callbackless bodies.
guidedPhasePolicy.lifetime: Cold report keeps its finite physical decay. Ignition voices retain projectile+guidedGeneration and are gated every frame by strict motorActive===true, !done, !launchPending, matching generation and local running system. On coast/done/reuse/pause/map/remote cancel stale gain automation and fade4ms/stop18ms. Callback occurs before motor flag is updated in same simulation step; frame gate consumes authoritative final powered state. Do not replay first ignition on correction/terminal burns.

swarmWallPolicy.position: centroid of actually burning local swarm bodies within1000
swarmWallPolicy.stop: Strict currently powered local swarm count<3, coast/done/remote/map/pause; cancel stale automation then fade4ms/stop18ms.12ms powered attack; sync each audio.update frame.
swarmWallPolicy.loopContract: Spawn once, update bounded density/pan/filter, retain native component while burning, stop on lifetime end. Score transport unchanged.
